description:
Fetch a URL and audit its delivered HTML against the WCAG ruleset — no need to paste markup. Runs entirely inside the agent's session.

Scope: with render='browser' (or 'auto' when a browser is available) this audits the JAVASCRIPT-RENDERED DOM including shadow DOM, and adds runtime-only checks (computed contrast, focus indicators, target size). With render='static' it reads only the server-delivered HTML — accurate for SSR/static pages, partial for client-only SPAs and blind to web components. The response always names the renderMode actually used. It is static analysis (see a11y_audit_html for the same caveats).

Args:
  - url (string): the http(s) page to audit.
  - rule_ids (string[], optional): restrict to specific rules.
  - response_format ('markdown'|'json'): default 'markdown'.

Returns (json): { url, finalUrl, status, ok, renderMode, degradedReason?, error?, result?: { summary, findings } }.

render.description: 'browser' renders in a headless browser (sees JS-rendered DOM and shadow DOM); 'static' fetches delivered HTML only; 'auto' prefers the browser and falls back to static, always reporting which was used.

rule_ids.description: Optional subset of rules. Available: img-alt, control-label, button-name, link-name, html-lang, heading-order, empty-heading, positive-tabindex, duplicate-id, valid-role, viewport-zoom, aria-hidden-focusable, label-for-target, contrast-inline, role-conflict, placeholder-label, aria-disabled-only, focus-outline-none, aria-idref.

url.description: The http(s) URL to fetch and audit.

name: a11y_audit_url
title: Audit a live URL for accessibility
